title: Trajectory lab

caption: Slide the probe radius through the surface and watch the field turn over.

caption: Change the two currents and see which regions of the field notice.

caption: Every point on a rolling wheel has a different speed. Drag the probe around the rim to find it.

caption: Angular momentum of a particle that is not going in a circle.

caption: Angular momentum is held fixed while you change the moment of inertia.

caption: A sticking collision solved by taking angular momentum about the pivot.

caption: How far can you push sin theta equals theta?

caption: The tangent line 1 + nx against the true curve.

caption: Three nearly equal pulls, and the small residue that survives subtraction.

caption: A car on a frictionless bank, seen end-on.

caption: Swing the cone wider and the ball speeds up while the period drops.

caption: Two arrows of equal length, set apart by the phase difference. The long arrow is what the ear gets, and the bar on the right tracks its length.

caption: Drag A along the curve. Everything moves downhill toward iron.

title: Mass defect balance
caption: The bound nucleus is lighter than its own parts. The gap is the binding energy.

title: Splitting lab
caption: Choose a parent nucleus and how evenly it splits, and watch whether the split pays.

title: One current element
caption: What a single piece of current sends to a point, and how the angle controls it.

caption: Stretch the wire and watch its field creep up to the infinite-wire answer.

caption: Slide the field point off the centre of a coil and watch the field collapse.

title: Polygon loop lab
caption: A polygon is one finite-wire formula used once per side.

caption: Radius grows as n squared, speed falls as 1 over n, and the whole atom shrinks as the nuclear charge rises.

title: Energy ladder and transitions
caption: Choose an upper and a lower level and read off the photon that comes out.

title: The hydrogen spectrum
caption: The three lowest series laid out on a logarithmic wavelength axis, with each series limit dashed.

caption: Three images make the potential vanish on both grounded planes.

title: Three standard shapes

Top block past the lower block

title: Ring on its axis
caption: Field on the axis of a uniformly charged ring.

title: Setting up the rod integral
caption: Why only one component survives on the perpendicular bisector.

title: Disk to infinite sheet
caption: Stacking rings into a disk, and watching the sheet limit appear.

title: Centripetal acceleration lab
caption: Speed and radius set the inward acceleration.

title: Vertical circle lab
caption: Set the speed at the top as a multiple of the critical speed and watch the tension.

params.label: Speed at top, in units of sqrt(gr)

title: Three free body diagrams
caption: The same rule, three geometries.

title: Restitution and the dying bounce
caption: Drop a ball and watch each bounce keep e squared of the previous height.

title: Elastic collision in a plane
caption: Change the mass ratio and the scattering angle, and watch the momentum triangle close.

title: Ballistic pendulum: two problems, not one
caption: The bang is a momentum problem; the swing is an energy problem. They meet at V.

title: Charge inside a conducting shell
caption: Induced charge bookkeeping on a hollow conductor.

title: Parallel-plate lab
caption: Change the geometry and the voltage, and watch C, Q, U and the pull between the plates follow.

title: Point charge above a grounded plate
caption: The field of a charge and its mirror image, and the surface charge it draws up under itself.

title: Two point charges
caption: Drag either charge past zero and the arrows flip.

title: Adding two fields
caption: Two like charges seen from a point on their bisector.

title: Two charged balls on threads
caption: The thread angle sets the balance between weight and Coulomb push.

title: Where the field vanishes
caption: Net field along the line between two positive charges.

title: The two normal modes
caption: In-phase and antiphase motion of two coupled carts.

title: Energy transfer lab
caption: Start cart 1 alone and watch the energy walk across to cart 2.

title: Uniform chain mode shapes
caption: Mode shapes and frequencies of N equal beads between fixed walls.

title: Resistance of a wire
caption: Length and thickness set the resistance; the material sets the constant.

title: Collapsing a series-parallel network
caption: Replace one unambiguous pair at a time until a single resistor is left.

title: Maximum power transfer lab
caption: Power into the load against load resistance, for a fixed source and cable.

title: Straightening a curve
caption: Pendulum periods at five lengths, plotted as T to a power you choose against L.

params.label: Power of T on the vertical axis

title: What a velocity-time graph gives you
caption: Slope is acceleration; shaded area is displacement.

title: Standard error lab
caption: Repeat a timing N times. The scatter stays; the uncertainty in the mean shrinks.

title: Least squares by hand
caption: Drag the slope and intercept and watch the sum of squared residuals.

title: Straightening an exponential
caption: Same data, two choices of vertical axis.

title: Error budget
caption: Which measurement actually limits the answer.

title: How big is a matter wave?
caption: Set a mass and a speed, and see where the de Broglie wavelength lands on a logarithmic ruler of real sizes.

title: Electron diffraction from a crystal
caption: Accelerating voltage sets the wavelength; the crystal spacing sets where the reflected beam comes back out.

title: Standing waves in a box
caption: Only whole numbers of half-wavelengths fit between the walls, and each one carries its own energy.

title: Secant to tangent lab
caption: Shrink h and watch the secant slope settle onto the derivative.

title: Where the slope is zero
caption: A maximum of x lines up with a zero of v, not a zero of x.

title: Sliding ladder lab
caption: The base moves at a constant speed. The top does not.

title: Polarization lab
caption: Bound charge on the slab faces cancels part of the free charge, so fewer field lines survive inside.

title: Series and parallel slabs
caption: The two ways a slab can fill part of a gap, and the rule for each.

title: Slab force lab
caption: A slab part way into a capacitor held at fixed voltage. The force does not depend on how far in it already is.

title: Path difference between two slits
caption: The extra distance the lower ray travels is d sin(theta).

title: Double-slit pattern with its envelope
caption: Interference fringes inside the single-slit envelope.

title: Grating sharpness lab
caption: More illuminated slits give narrower peaks in the same places.

title: Moving source lab
caption: Push the source speed past the speed of sound and the circles pile up into a cone.

title: Where the wavelength goes
caption: Three crests, one period apart, drawn at the moment the third leaves the source.

title: Echo lab: two shifts, one after the other
caption: The wall hears one shifted frequency, then re-emits it and shifts it again on the way back.

title: Reading a potential curve
caption: Flat spots, curvature, and which way the force points.

title: Curvature sets the frequency
caption: Change the well and watch the predicted frequency change with it.

title: Effective potential for a central force
caption: The centrifugal barrier, the energy line, and the turning points it cuts.

title: Potential along a line of two charges
caption: Drag the probe and read V off the curve. The field is the slope, not the height.

title: Charge released on the axis of a ring
caption: An electron dropped onto the axis of a positive ring. Watch it fall into the centre and overshoot.

title: Equipotentials and field lines
caption: Field lines cross equipotentials at right angles. Where the rings crowd, the field is strong.
